label: Bible Study
prompt: Is any sick among you? let him call for the _____ of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
verse: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
note: James' instructions for the sick — call the church elders, pray, and anoint with oil.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he _____ us:
verse: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
note: John's confidence about prayer: ask according to God's will, and He hears.

label: Sunday School
prompt: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his _____.
verse: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
note: Joseph's dying wish was to have his bones carried out of Egypt — and Moses kept the promise (Exodus 13:19).

label: Deep Water
prompt: And no marvel; for Satan himself is _____ into an angel of light.
verse: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
note: Paul's warning about false apostles: deception rarely shows up looking dark — it dresses as light.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the _____ shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
verse: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
note: Valleys raised, mountains lowered, 'the crooked shall be made straight' — road crews clearing the way for the coming King.
